desc: Ideation: enumerate the smaller side r=min(K,N-K); if enumerating complements use chosen_xor = total_xor ^ complement_xor.
Implement fast stdin parsing and compute total = XOR(A).
Implement iterative lexicographic index-combination generation for r indices from range(N), including r == 0 handling.
For each combination compute s = XOR(A[i] for i in idx); candidate = s if r == K else total ^ s; track ans = max(ans, candidate).
Micro-optimize inner loop with local bindings and avoid storing combinations or recursion.
Verify edge cases: K=0/K=N, duplicates, all zeros, and brute-force cross-check on small random cases.
